The Canvas simulation in this directory is adapted from [stackedlol/ascii-sharks](https://github.com/stackedlol/ascii-sharks), pinned to commit `a0074c16a106f0abc665fe9712ca445f8f98ad8e`.

The upstream project is distributed under the MIT License in `LICENSE`. The dark fish and shark palette follows the pinned upstream source. The login canvas includes sea turtles, manta rays, dolphins, yellow tangs and a humpback whale in both Core-backed appearance themes, with colors adapted to the black or light lagoon background. The configured login image remains visible through the light water layer. Geist Mono 600 is self-hosted as an exact-glyph WOFF2 subset under the SIL Open Font License in `/fonts/geist-mono-OFL.txt`.
